pattern_explanation: Turkish borrowed several home-related words from European languages such as French, so their spelling looks close to English. Over time the meanings shifted in Turkish, which is why these look-alike words now name different things in English.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish word spelled like the English word salon means living room, not a hair or beauty salon. The Turkish word spelled like apartman names a whole building with many flats, while English apartment usually means a single flat.
